-- Find Helsinki Pitäjänmäki store
SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, city
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' AND city LIKE '%Helsinki%'
AND is_current = TRUE

calls.statement:
-- Find period 5 fiscal dates for the current year context
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Top 3 products by units sold at Helsinki Pitäjänmäki in period 5 FY2026/27
SELECT 
  p.product_key,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rc.period_start_date AND rc.period_end_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4  -- Helsinki Pitäjänmäki
  AND rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rc.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Verify store and period context
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  rc.fiscal_year,
  rc.fiscal_period,
  rc.period_start_date,
  rc.period_end_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as sales_lines,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rc.period_start_date AND rc.period_end_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rc.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, rc.fiscal_year, rc.fiscal_period, rc.period_start_date, rc.period_end_date

-- Final query: Top 3 products by units sold at Helsinki Pitäjänmäki in period 5 FY2026/27
SELECT 
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rc.period_start_date AND rc.period_end_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rc.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
